item.text: {"action":"run","arguments_json":"{\"command\":[\"python\",\"-c\",\"import copy,json,work\\n\\ncases=[\\n ({'declared':['b','a','a'],'saved':{'a':{'kind':'file','hash':'x'},'b':{'kind':'file','hash':'x'}},'current':{'a':{'hash':'y','kind':'file'},'b':{'hash':'x','kind':'file'}}},{'ignored':[]},{'needs_review':True,'changed':['a']}),\\n ({'declared':['missing'],'saved':{},'current':{}},{'ignored':[]},{'needs_review':False,'changed':[]}),\\n ({'declared':['missing'],'saved':{'missing':{'kind':'missing'}},'current':{}},{'ignored':[]},{'needs_review':False,'changed':[]}),\\n ({'declared':['x'],'saved':{'x':{'kind':'file','meta':{'b':2,'a':1}}},'current':{'x':{'meta':{'a':1,'b':2},'kind':'file'}}},{'ignored':[]},{'needs_review':False,'changed':[]}),\\n ({'declared':['x'],'saved':{'x':{'kind':'file','hash':'a'}},'current':{'x':{'kind':'file','hash':'b'}}},{'ignored':['x']},{'needs_review':False,'changed':[]})\\n]\\nfor req,pol,want in cases:\\n before=(copy.deepcopy(req),copy.deepcopy(pol)); got=work.evaluate(req,pol); assert got==want,(got,want); assert (req,pol)==before\\nrequests=json.load(open('requests.json')); policy=json.load(open('policy.json')); report=json.load(open('report.json')); assert report==[work.evaluate(r,policy) for r in requests]\\nprint('ok')\"]}"}
